title: Require Recipe Stage Source Topology
forbids: recipe stage collections or semantic containers outside the closed recipe-stage blueprint topology, including recipe-owned artifact directories
why: Physical stage source may nest by semantic hierarchy independently of runtime stage IDs. Every semantic container admits only nested kebab-case containers or canonical stage support surfaces. An index.ts marks that container as an authored stage; containers without one remain non-stage family containers. Ordinary public configuration is inferred from step schemas, bound operation configuration, and stage knobs. A rare intentional full public override is defined inline by the concrete stage and compiled there, so external public-config assemblies cannot become a parallel authoring authority. Steps are a reserved subtree owned by the recipe-step blueprint, while immutable pipeline data-product contracts remain with their domain owner. Stable live-log wire projections belong to a recipe parity or evidence owner rather than a stage-local log cabinet.
remediate: Place source under a semantic stage container, use only the canonical support filenames, let steps and bound operations expose ordinary configuration, and inline any justified full public override with its meaningful compiler in the concrete stage index. Move immutable artifact contracts to the producing domain, move stable live-log wire projections to the recipe parity or evidence owner, and delete stage-local log cabinets and engine observations or diagnostic projections that are not artifacts.
message: Recipe stage source must match the positive recursive semantic-container topology.
